item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00502","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C02","C09","C18"],"selected_candidate_label":"C02","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C02 supplies a highly specific drafting template: corporation tax materials for a taxable-year window ending after June 30 and before July 1 are opened to inspection by a federal body as an aid in executing powers conferred by its organic statute, subject to Treasury rules in a contemporaneously approved Treasury decision, followed by the identical Federal Register effectiveness clause. The child adapts that machinery from Federal Trade Commission returns to Federal Reserve Board statistical transcript cards. C09 shares nearly all of the same operative language and is temporally closer, but C02 additionally matches the child's distinctive June-to-July taxable-year window. C18 is a weaker predecessor using the same tax-inspection/Treasury-decision framework without the more distinctive statutory-purpose and compliance language.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"statistical transcript cards submitted with, or prepared by the Internal Revenue Service from, corporation income tax returns for the taxable years ending after June 30, 1951, and before July 1, 1952","parent_excerpt":"corporation income tax returns made for the calendar year 1949 and fiscal years ending in the calendar year 1949 and for any taxable year ending after June 30, 1949, and before July 1, 1950","explanation":"Both identify corporation-tax records through the distinctive taxable-year window bounded by June 30 and July 1, with the child updating the years and specifying transcript cards."},{"child_excerpt":"shall be open to inspection by the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System as an aid in executing the powers
